source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: A psychic level 1 ability. During your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), if a unit embarked in this unit is chosen for a **disembark move**, provided this unit is not itself **battle-shocked**, you may make a **psychic roll** of one D6 for it. If you do, a 1 battle-shocks this unit, and either way attacks made by the disembarking unit against **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** units get +1 to their [Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) until the turn ends.
